parties: T T Limited; Sanjay Kumar Jain (promoter group member)
headline: T T Limited: Promoter Group Acquisition of 54,300 Shares
sum: Sanjay Kumar Jain, a promoter group member of T T Limited, acquired 54,300 shares, disclosed to NSE under SEBI Regulation 29 (LODR 2015) on 19 June 2026.
implication: Routine promoter shareholding disclosure under SEBI LODR-flags the two-business-day reporting window and mandatory exchange notification as a governance/market transparency checkpoint for insider share movements.
detail: T T Limited notified the NSE of Sanjay Kumar Jain's acquisition of 54,300 shares on 19 June 2026. The disclosure was mandated under Regulation 29 of SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations, 2015, which requires material changes in shareholding by promoters, promoter group members, and directors to be reported within two business days of the transaction. No transaction price or consideration was disclosed in the filing.
